repo.description: The repository to get the issue from.

languageModelTools.name: github-pull-request_currentActivePullRequest
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get comprehensive information about the active GitHub pull request (PR). The active PR is the one that is currently checked out. This includes the PR title, full description, list of changed files, review comments, and PR state. For PRs created by Copilot, it also includes the session logs which indicate the development process and decisions made by the coding agent. Does NOT include status checks/CI results; use the pullRequestStatusChecks tool instead. When asked about the active or current pull request, do this first! Use this tool for any request related to "current changes," "pull request details," "what changed," or similar queries even if the user does not explicitly mention "pull request." When asked to use this tool, ALWAYS use it.

refresh.description: Whether to fetch fresh data from GitHub or return cached data. Set to true to ensure the most up-to-date information, especially after recent changes. Set to false to improve performance when up-to-date information is not critical.

languageModelTools.name: github-pull-request_pullRequestStatusChecks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the status checks and CI failures for a GitHub pull request (PR). This includes check run statuses, workflow names, failure logs, and review requirements (approvals needed, current approvals, requested changes). Use this tool when the user asks about CI status/failures, build results, check runs, status checks, whether a PR is ready to merge, or similar queries. Requires a pull request number.

repo.description: The repository to get the pull request status checks from.

pullRequestNumber.description: The number of the pull request to get status checks for.

languageModelTools.name: github-pull-request_pullRequestInViewport
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get comprehensive information about the GitHub pull request (PR) which is currently visible, but not necessarily checked out. This is the pull request that the user is currently viewing. This includes the PR title, full description, list of changed files, review comments, and PR state. For PRs created by Copilot, it also includes the session logs which indicate the development process and decisions made by the coding agent. Does NOT include status checks/CI results; use the pullRequestStatusChecks tool instead. When asked about the currently open pull request, do this first! Use this tool for any request related to "pull request details," "what changed," or similar queries even if the user does not explicitly mention "pull request." When asked to use this tool, ALWAYS use it.

languageModelTools.name: github-pull-request_create_pull_request
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new GitHub pull request. Requires a title and head branch. The base branch and repo default to the repository defaults. Returns the created pull request number, URL, and details.

repo.description: The repository to create the pull request in.

title.description: The title of the pull request.

body.description: The body/description of the pull request.

head.description: The name of the branch where your changes are implemented (branch name only, without owner prefix).

headOwner.description: The owner of the head branch repository. Defaults to the origin/push remote repository owner.

base.description: The name of the branch you want the changes pulled into. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

draft.description: Indicates whether the pull request is a draft.

languageModelTools.name: github-pull-request_resolveReviewThread
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resolve a review thread on the active GitHub pull request. Use the threadId from the reviewThreads array returned by the activePullRequest tool. Only resolves threads where canResolve is true and isResolved is false.

threadId.description: The GraphQL node ID of the review thread to resolve. Obtain this from the id field in the reviewThreads array of the activePullRequest tool output.

path.description: Optional changed-file path to read immutable base and source content.

languageModelTools.name: azure-devops_pull_request_checks

languageModelTools.name: azure-devops_create_pull_request

languageModelTools.name: azure-devops_resolve_review_thread
